entitlement_management._comment: Lab 27 (SC-300 4.1, 1.3). Entitlement management in Microsoft Entra ID Governance, written as a generic rule engine. Day counts are relative to the scenario date.

scope_types.internal_users: members of this directory (employees); guests are not included
scope_types.connected_organizations: external users from the connected organizations listed on the policy
scope_types.all_connected_organizations: external users from any connected organization in the 'configured' state
scope_types.any_external: any external user, including people from organizations that are not connected yet
scope_types.admin_only: nobody can request; administrators assign directly

approver_tokens.internal_sponsor: the internal sponsors of the requester's connected organization
approver_tokens.external_sponsor: the external sponsors of the requester's connected organization

rule_definitions.unknown_requester: requester is not a known user (deny by default)
rule_definitions.unknown_package: access package (or its catalog) does not exist (deny by default)
rule_definitions.not_in_scope: no assignment policy on the package lets this requester ask for it
rule_definitions.catalog_not_external: the catalog is not enabled for external users
rule_definitions.sod_conflict: requester already holds an access package listed as incompatible
rule_definitions.missing_justification: the policy requires a business justification and none (or too short) was given
rule_definitions.approver_is_requester: the only approver left is the requester, who can never approve their own request
rule_definitions.no_approver: no approver or fallback approver could be found for a stage
rule_definitions.auto_approval: the policy needs no approval, so access is delivered at once
rule_definitions.single_stage: the request waits for one approval stage
rule_definitions.two_stage: the request waits for two approval stages in order

assignment_outcomes.ACTIVE: assignment is delivered and not close to expiry
assignment_outcomes.EXPIRING_SOON: assignment ends within the warning window: the user should extend or lose access
assignment_outcomes.EXPIRED: assignment reached its end date and the access was removed
assignment_outcomes.REMOVED: assignment was ended early (by an administrator or an access review)
assignment_outcomes.INVALID: assignment points at an unknown user or package: remove it (deny by default)

guest_outcomes.GUEST_ACTIVE: external user still has at least one active assignment
guest_outcomes.GUEST_BLOCKED: last assignment ended: blocked from sign-in, removal is scheduled
guest_outcomes.GUEST_REMOVAL_DUE: last assignment ended at least the removal period ago: delete the guest account
guest_outcomes.GUEST_NOT_MANAGED: guest was invited outside entitlement management, so these lifecycle settings do not apply: review it another way

concepts.catalog: A container that holds resources (groups, applications, SharePoint sites) and the access packages built from them, with its own owners.
concepts.access package: A bundle of resource roles that a user requests and receives together, for example a site plus a group plus an app role.
concepts.assignment policy: The rules on an access package that say who can request it, who approves, whether a justification is needed and when access expires.
concepts.connected organization: A partner directory or domain registered so its users can request access packages; it is either configured or proposed.
concepts.incompatible access package: A package listed on another package so that holding one blocks requests for the other, enforcing separation of duties.
concepts.fallback approver: An approver used when the normal approver for a stage cannot be found, such as a requester with no manager.
concepts.external user lifecycle: Settings that block a guest added by entitlement management when their last assignment ends and delete them after a set number of days.
